snippet.title: SCHOOLBOUND - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
PLAY FOR FREE NOW ON ITCH:
cobolo.itch.io/schoolbound

Schoolbound is a 3D Stealth Horror Narrative set to evoke the nostalgia of spine-chilling rumours of a primary school.

Brave the nights for a chance to complete the Cobolo Primary 30th Anniversary card collection and uncover the secrets of the school. 

Any support or feedback appreciated!

TWITTER: @SchoolboundGame
INSTAGRAM: @schoolbound_game
TIKTOK: @schoolbound_game

-Play as a student and discover the Haunted Card Binder of the past and the Ghosts bound to it
-Survive nights of Stealth Horror as you stay back at school to find loot left during the day, while hiding or escaping from the ghosts that roam the buildings
-Return your loot to the suspicious Bookstore Auntie to buy more cards to complete your collection

THANK YOU
